The parent handoff example independently checks selected inference and type-sensitive canonical receipt identity before state adoption.
Bounded author diagnostics and answer-only retry feedback preserve preceding executed authority; future bindings do not become authority.
Execution pins now register43 Python files:35 required and8 optional, including the authoring helper.

limits: No new small-model quality or overall cost improvement is claimed for this release.
proof_step acceptance establishes the selected inference validity; a valid partial inference need not advance the intended plan.
Deterministic acceptance and canonical output contracts do not guarantee every model can construct a satisfying answer.
Authoring, schema grammar, repairs and whole-project costs require separate measurement.
